section:
### Comparison of the arms

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 3. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 29 | 250 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Side effects | 35 | 250 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 42 | 250 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Side effects | 40 | 250 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
